paper.title_en: Bjorken-xx Weighted Energy-Energy Correlator: Bridging TFR and CFR
paper.abstract_en: Understanding the internal structure of the nucleon and the mechanism of hadronization constitutes a primary scientific driver for the Electron-Ion Collider (EIC). The Nucleon Energy-Energy Correlator (NEEC) offers unique advantages for this pursuit, being largely insensitive to soft radiation and immune to Sudakov suppression in the target fragmentation region (TFR). In this proceeding, based on our publication Ref. [1], we present the complete spectrum for the Bjorken-$x$ weighted EEC in DIS, spanning from the TFR to the current fragmentation region (CFR). Using the Soft-Collinear Effective Theory (SCET), we perform resummation of large logarithms up to NLL accuracy in the TFR and $\rm N^3LL$ in the TMD region. Finally, numerical predictions for EIC and CEBAF kinematics are presented, revealing a transition from the perturbative phase to a free hadron gas phase in the small-angle limit.
